configuration.storage: Map implementing getItem/setItem; no Web Storage I/O

method.scope: Exact objects and own-property slots reachable from the private checked root. The store API object, function closures, existing scene, test hooks and temporary probe Sets are outside this cache inventory.
method.strings: UTF-16 code units and UTF-8 encoded lengths describe retained raw values, not V8 heap bytes. Map and the cache can share the same immutable string; distinct physical string allocations or engine representation are not inferred.
method.instrumentation: Only an in-memory copy of save-games.js exposes the private root. All game modules and the real snapshot fixture load from the selected checkout. No production getter, file mutation, timer, forced GC or heap delta.
method.boundedness: Four to eight changed revisions per mode, then caller mutation, quota failure, external corruption, valid external replacement, deletion and empty-slot quota failure. After deletion the checked root remains, but zero records and zero raw values are retained.
